title: calystegia japonica f. albiflora
intro: Calystegia japonica f. albiflora, commonly known as Japanese Morning Glory White, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Convolvulaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Calystegia japonica f. albiflora are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can promote relaxation and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
